entities.summary: The National University of Samoa is the only national university in Samoa. Established in 1984 by an act of parliament, it is coeducational and provides certificate, diploma, and undergraduate degree programs, as well as technical and vocational training. About 2,000 students were enrolled in 2010 with an estimated 300 staff. It offers a wide range of programmes including Arts, Business and Entrepreneurship, Education, Science, Nursing, Engineering and Maritime Training. The Centre for Samoan Studies, established in the university for the teaching of the Samoan language and culture, offers undergraduate and graduate degrees as well as the world's first degree in Master of Samoan Studies.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The National University of Samoa has played a crucial role in promoting Samoan language and culture, offering undergraduate and graduate degrees in Master of Samoan Studies, which is the world's first degree in this field. This initiative has contributed to the preservation and promotion of Samoan heritage.
